findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_company_info" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "What this company sells, who it is for, and every agent/API entry point. No account needed." → after: "Who runs Empire Orchestrator, what it does, and where to find pricing and contact pages."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
